items.name: Clifford Burden Jr.

The bare 'Clifford' in the same block's bracket ('…Robert Ross, and Clifford in a pseudo-Hawaiian setting') is in a 1930s photograph, so it must be Clifford Burden Sr. (296333), whom Liston knew ('Oh yeah. He and Minnie both dead, huh?').

items.notes: Upstream wrongly called him the son of Liston's ex-husband. Bryant's 'Minnie’s ex-husband – widow' refers to Minnie's widower. The 'Clifford' surface form should go to Clifford Burden Sr.

upstream.evidence: The interviewee does not speak about Clifford, Jr. in this context; the mention is made by the interviewer identifying him as the son of the interviewee's ex-husband.
